As I parted from my stout old friend Joliet, I saw him turn to empty the last half of our bottle into the glasses of a couple of tired soldiers who were sucking their pipes on a bench. And again the old proverb of Aretino came into my head: "Truly all courtesy and good manners come from taverns." I grasped my botany-box and pursued my promenade toward Noisy.

32195-the-battle-of-blenheim.title: Blenheim
32195-the-battle-of-blenheim.creator: Hilaire Belloc
32195-the-battle-of-blenheim.description: A book by Hilaire Belloc. A campaign, again, is but the armed effort of one society to impose its will in some particular upon another society. Every such effort must have a definite political object. If this object is served the campaign is successful. If it is not served the campaign is a failure.

55959-the-coming-of-the-white-men-storie.title: Stories of How Our Country was Discovered

55959-the-coming-of-the-white-men-storie.description: A book by Mary Hazelton Wade. His real name was Ebenezer Wilkins, but the children had to stop and think before they could remember it. He lived in a cosy little cottage at the end of the village and kept house there all alone from one year's end to another.

arxiv-2203-03370.title: Complete dark energy scenario in f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity
arxiv-2203-03370.creator: Raja Solanki, Avik De, P.K. Sahoo
arxiv-2203-03370.description: Abstract In theoretical physics, the fundamental nature and evolution mechanism of dark energy is still an open question. In General Relativity Theory, the simplest explanation for dark energy is the cosmological constant Λ \Lambda . However, the cosmological constant Λ \Lambda facing a sensitive problem called fine-tunning problem.

arxiv-2205-06201.title: Half-metallicity and two-dimensional hole gas at the BiFeO 3 \text{BiFeO}_{\text{3}} (001) surface
arxiv-2205-06201.creator: Soumyasree Jena, Sanjoy Datta
arxiv-2205-06201.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Soumyasree Jena, Sanjoy Datta. The electronic structure and thermodynamic stability of tetragonal BiFeO 3 \rm{BiFeO_{3}} (001) surfaces have been investigated using density functional theory. In this work, four different structures having different lattice constants with two possible surface terminations have been studied. We have found that the surface electronic structure and the thermodynamic stability is quite sensitive with respect to the nature of the surface termination.

arxiv-2206-06004.title: A Novel Multi-Layer Modular Approach for Real-Time Fuzzy-Identification of Gravitational-Wave Signals
arxiv-2206-06004.creator: Marco Russo
arxiv-2206-06004.description: Abstract Advanced LIGO and Advanced Virgo ground-based interferometers are instruments capable to detect gravitational wave signals exploiting advanced laser interferometry techniques. The underlying data analysis task consists in identifying specific patterns in noisy timeseries, but it is made extremely complex by the incredibly small amplitude of the target signals.

arxiv-2206-09038.title: Validation of Vector Data using Oblique Images DOI: 10.1145/1463434.1463464 Conference: 16th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems; June 5–7, 2008; Irvine, CA, USA. Price: 5.00 ISBN: 978-1-60558-323-5/08/11 CCS: Computing methodologies Scene understand
arxiv-2206-09038.creator: Pragyana Mishra, Eyal Ofek, Gur Kimchi
arxiv-2206-09038.description: Abstract . Oblique images are aerial photographs taken at oblique angles to the earth’s surface. Projections of vector and other geospatial data in these images depend on camera parameters, positions of the geospatial entities, surface terrain, occlusions, and visibility. This paper presents a robust and scalable algorithm to detect inconsistencies in vector data using oblique images.

arxiv-2307-11228.title: From Adaptive Query Release to Machine Unlearning
arxiv-2307-11228.creator: Enayat Ullah, Raman Arora
arxiv-2307-11228.description: Abstract We formalize the problem of machine unlearning as design of efficient unlearning algorithms corresponding to learning algorithms which perform a selection of adaptive queries from structured query classes. We give efficient unlearning algorithms for linear and prefix-sum query classes.

arxiv-2309-17145.title: Staying at the Roach Motel: Cross-Country Analysis of Manipulative Subscription and Cancellation Flows Conference: Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 11–16, 2024; Honolulu, HI, USA Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI
arxiv-2309-17145.creator: Ashley Sheil, Gunes Acar, Hanna Schraffenberger, Raphaël Gellert, David Malone
arxiv-2309-17145.description: Abstract . Subscribing to online services is typically a straightforward process, but cancelling them can be arduous and confusing — causing many to resign and continue paying for services they no longer use. Making the cancellation process intentionally difficult is recognized as a dark pattern called Roach Motel .

arxiv-2406-06172.title: Higgs cross-section (including di-Higgs) with CMS and ATLAS
arxiv-2406-06172.creator: T. Lange on behalf of the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations
arxiv-2406-06172.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by T. Lange on behalf of the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations. Since the discovery of the Higgs boson in 2012 by the ATLAS and CMS Collaborations a lot of progress has been made in verifying the nature of this new bosonic particle. Still, questions remain as to whether this new particle is the standard model (SM) Higgs boson, and whether it gives us hints of where physics beyond the SM (BSM) might be hidden.

arxiv-2410-23950.title: Gravitational memory: new results from post-Newtonian and self-force theory
arxiv-2410-23950.creator: Kevin Cunningham , 1 Chris Kavanagh , 1 Adam Pound , 2 David Trestini , 2 Niels Warburton , 1 Jakob Neef 1
arxiv-2410-23950.description: Abstract We compute the (displacement) gravitational wave memory due to a quasi-circular inspiral of two black holes using a variety of perturbative techniques. Within post-Newtonian theory, we extend previous results to 3.5PN order, both for non-spinning compact binaries and for non-precessing, spinning binary black holes (including horizon flux contributions).

arxiv-2511-21721.creator: Gao Mo, Naveen Raman, Megan Chai, Cindy Peng, Shannon Pagdon, Nev Jones, Hong Shen, Peggy Swarbrick, Fei Fang
arxiv-2511-21721.description: Abstract Behavioral health conditions, which include mental health and substance use disorders, are the leading disease burden in the United States. Peer-run behavioral health organizations ( pro s) critically assist individuals facing these conditions by combining mental health services with assistance for needs such as income, employment, and housing.

pmc-11304608.creator: Tracey Pérez Koehlmoos, Elizabeth Lee, Ilse Rivera, Jennifer Wisdahl, Katie Erdman, Tom Donaldson
pmc-11304608.description: It is estimated that up to 1 in 20 people in the United States may have a fetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD), or the array of physical, cognitive, emotional, and social disorders caused by exposure to alcohol during prenatal development (May et al., JAMA 319:474–82, 2018).

pmc-13547537.title: Analysis of Suffix Use for Biosimilar Product Identification in Postmarketing Adverse Event Reporting
pmc-13547537.creator: Danijela Stojanovic, Lisa Wolf, M. Stacey Ricci, Monica A. Muñoz
pmc-13547537.description: Accurate identification of medicines used in adverse event reports is crucial for effective postmarketing safety surveillance. The US Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) four‐letter suffix naming convention was designed to facilitate accurate biological product identification, but the extent to which these suffixes have been incorporated into biosimilar reporting remains unclear.

pmc-13654947.title: SUV39H2-mediated NCOA4 methylation controls ferritinophagy and ferroptosis in triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-13654947.creator: Lingxia Liu, Xinyun Pei, Ding Li, Ying Huo, Zhaoting Wang, Qiu Zhang, Yuan Yue, Bao Deng, Minmin Yu, Tong Xu, Lei Zhong, Xianhui Ruan, Xichuan Li
pmc-13654947.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) exhibits iron homeostasis that supports tumor growth and proliferation, yet the regulatory mechanisms controlling iron flux remain poorly defined. Here, we identify a ferritinophagic cargo receptor NCOA4 as a novel substrate of the lysine methyltransferase SUV39H2, uncovering a previously unrecognized mechanism that regulates ferritinophagy and ferroptosis.

pmc-13656475.title: Bilibili and Douyin (Chinese TikTok) videos as sources of health information about ventricular septal defect: a cross-sectional content and quality analysis of top-ranked patient-facing videos
pmc-13656475.creator: Xuping Zhang, Yimamujiang Aximu, Peipei Zhang
pmc-13656475.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe rapid growth of short-form social media and video-sharing platforms has greatly expanded public access to health information; however, the characteristics and quality of videos concerning ventricular septal defect (VSD) have not yet been systematically evaluated. Although VSD is a well-established congenital heart disease, patients and caregivers may still rely on social media to understand diagnosis, prognosis, follow-up, and treatment options.
